name: std-thread
description: std-thread — forum-style nested replies with collapse + flat-mode toggle. Owns ThreadPost (persistent). flat:true covers 1:1 linear inquiry threads; flat:false renders forum-style nested. INIT fetches, scoped by @config.threadRootId when set (blank = every root, the default). REPLY persists a child post under @payload.parentId, stamped with the real @user identity. A consumer that mounts this as page comments forwards its own document-opened signal to SET_THREAD_ROOT { rootId }, which stamps the frame and refetches filtered by the payload; the after-create and after-select refetch arms keep filtering by @config.threadRootId, so a mutation re-widens the panel until the consumer re-fires SET_THREAD_ROOT. Layer 3 variants override `bodyContent` to deliver chat-bubble, email-threaded, or linear-comments UX while inheriting the same trait, state machine, emits, and listens. A non-empty sectionTitle switches the default bodyContent into titled-comments mode: header + post list + a standalone composer button (without it an empty thread has no REPLY emitter at all — the affordance only existed per-row).

fields.name: parentId
fields.description: Identifier of the parent ThreadPost in a nested thread.

fields.name: threadRootId
fields.description: Identifier of the top-level thread this post belongs to.

fields.name: authorId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the post's author.

fields.name: authorName
fields.description: The name of the post's author.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The main text content of the post.

fields.name: voteCount
fields.description: The number of votes associated with this item.

fields.name: replyCount
fields.description: The number of replies to this post.
fields.synonyms: count, number of replies, child posts

fields.name: replies
fields.description: A list of child ThreadPost entities.

fields.name: focusedRow
fields.description: The currently selected or active row within the thread.

emits.description: Indicates a post or reply has been chosen for interaction.
Indicates a new reply has been created and added to the thread.
Indicates a reply has been modified.
Signals the composed draft should be persisted as a new post — the draft is read from the entity frame (@entity.content), so bare buttons can emit it.
Indicates a reply creation was aborted by the user.
Signals a thread post has been successfully retrieved.
Indicates a failure to load a thread post.
emits.synonyms: load error, fetch failed, retrieval failed

emits.description: A new post has been added to the thread — payload is the created ThreadPost row itself (flat: ?id, ?threadRootId, ?authorId, ?content, …), not wrapped under a row field.
Indicates a failure to create a new thread post.

events.name: ThreadPost loaded
events.description: Signals a thread post has been successfully retrieved.

events.name: ThreadPost load failed
events.description: Indicates a failure to load a thread post.
events.synonyms: load error, fetch failed, retrieval failed

events.name: Set Thread Root
events.description: Scopes every fetch, and new-reply threadRootId stamping, to the descendants of one document root.
events.synonyms: scope, focus, set root, document scope, thread scope

events.name: Reply
events.description: Indicates a new reply has been created and added to the thread.

events.name: ThreadPost created
events.description: A new post has been added to the thread — payload is the created ThreadPost row itself (flat: ?id, ?threadRootId, ?authorId, ?content, …), not wrapped under a row field.

events.name: Select
events.description: Indicates a post or reply has been chosen for interaction.

events.name: Edit Reply
events.description: Indicates a reply has been modified.

events.name: Submit Reply
events.description: Signals the composed draft should be persisted as a new post — the draft is read from the entity frame (@entity.content), so bare buttons can emit it.

events.name: Cancel Reply
events.description: Indicates a reply creation was aborted by the user.

events.name: ThreadPost create failed

bodyContent.label: Body content tree
bodyContent.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after thread posts load. Default is the canonical forum-style data-list. Layer 3 variants override this with their own tree (chat bubbles, email-threaded cards, linear comment stacks, etc.) to deliver entirely different thread UX while inheriting the same trait, state machine, emits, and listens.

sectionTitle.label: sectionTitle
sectionTitle.description: Section header rendered by the default bodyContent when non-empty, along with a standalone composer button — the only REPLY affordance an empty thread has. Blank (the default) keeps the bare post list for embedded threads that bring their own chrome (chat rails, custom comment sections).

threadRootId.label: Root post id
threadRootId.description: Top-level post whose descendants are loaded, filters every fetch and defaults new top-level replies' threadRootId (blank = all roots, unfiltered)
